assets.name: 箭步：上砍
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: game card artwork ONLY, 1000x760 landscape composition, opaque full-bleed image.
Primary request: redraw Wylder's "Stamp: Upward Cut" card following the ATTACHED POSE REFERENCE precisely.
Input images: Image 1 is the anatomical POSE master, not the materials or character; Image 2 is Wylder identity, outfit, helmet and weapon reference ONLY, not its idle pose or detailed rendering; Images 3 and 4 are original game card-art STYLE references, not their subjects or curved weapons.
Visual event: Wylder has just driven a one-handed greatsword UPWARD, arm stretched up-left, other fist raised for balance, in the exact lifted open-chested stance of Image 1.
Pose: torso turns three-quarter to the RIGHT, head looking right. Right sword arm extends to upper LEFT of the picture; the single sword is held upright, blade directed toward upper-left, grip below guard, forked pommel below the grip. Other arm is bent and its closed fist raised at upper right beside the helmet. Bent knees in a wide forward stepping stance. Preserve the reference's open shoulder silhouette. ONE hand on ONE sword; do not invent a two-handed overhead strike or a downward cut.
Identity: full CLOSED silver helmet with small segmented metal feather wing and dark eye slit, silver front faceguard distinct from blue SIDE/BACK panel, black neck scarf, simplified V-shaped silver breastplate, asymmetrical shoulders, grouped silver scales, brown gloves, deep navy split skirt with a few flowing silver motifs, dark trousers and rope-wrapped boots. Discreet small round navy buckler strapped on back, not in the raised fist.
Weapon invariant: ONE very long broad STRAIGHT greatsword, not a curved saber. Forked sculptural silver pommel, long navy grip, compact silver crossguard. The pommel's CENTRAL base, grip centerline, guard center, entire blade centerline and tip form ONE STRAIGHT CONTINUOUS LINE. Decorative pommel branches may curve outward; the shaft never bends. Simplify the original ornament into 2-3 bold silver motifs, no dense metal engraving. Fit the whole blade if possible; lower calves may crop for landscape.
Style: graphic 2D fantasy card illustration matching the original-game STYLE images: chunky angular silhouettes, broad flat color blocks, 2-4 HARD-EDGED cel-shaded planes per material, heavy irregular BLACK shadow shapes, intentionally exaggerated hands and perspective. No realistic metal reflection, no fine scales, no painterly gradients on armor.
Composition: upper body, raised fist and near-vertical straight sword form one immediately legible rising action filling 80% of frame. Strong warm orange upward slash ribbon SEPARATE from the solid straight steel blade. Minimal deep navy/near-black abstract background with a few large diagonals. Cold silver/navy character and bright orange/cream action accent. Large clean color shapes, readable at 250x190.
Avoid: text, lettering, symbols resembling UI, card frame, card backs, logos, watermark, extra limbs, duplicate swords, two handles, bent blade, broken grip axis, ball pommel, exposed face, blue cloth face mask, orange glowing eyes, realistic texture, painterly brushwork, cinematic fog, detailed scenery, dense ornament.

assets.name: 箭步：回旋斩
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: game card artwork ONLY, 1000x760 landscape composition, opaque full-bleed image.
Primary request: redraw Wylder's "Stamp: Spinning Slash" card by translating the exact movement in POSE Image 1 into the armored character.
Input images: Image 1 is the anatomical POSE master, not its stone mannequin surface; Image 2 is Wylder identity, helmet, outfit and weapon ONLY, not its idle pose or rendering style; Images 3 and 4 are original game card-art STYLE references, not their characters or curved weapons.
Visual event: a low twisting step and one-handed reverse sweep: Wylder rotates his back and hips toward the viewer, head turns right, sword trails behind him toward lower LEFT.
Pose must match Image 1: low center of gravity, bent forward right knee, rear leg extended back-left, body shown three-quarter BACK with helmet in right-facing profile, near shoulder raised by torso rotation. Sword arm stretches back-left and holds ONE sword in ONE hand behind the body, the greatsword blade pointing diagonally DOWN-LEFT from guard to tip. Free fist stretches FORWARD-RIGHT to counterbalance. Do not change this to a front-facing knight holding a sword horizontally in both hands. Preserve the deep twisting body line and opposing hand positions.
Identity: full closed silver helmet with segmented metal feather wing, engraved dome simplified into 2-3 bold flowing marks, dark eye slit and silver front faceguard; blue panel ONLY on helmet side/back. Black neck scarf and short back drapery. Silver shoulder armor, groups of angular scales, navy knee-length split skirt, sparse silver flowing embroidery, broad brown belt and brown gloves, dark trousers, rope-wrapped lower legs. A small navy round buckler is secured to back and visible only as a compact partial circle, never obscuring the body turn or reaching hand.
Weapon invariant: ONE very long broad STRAIGHT greatsword with forked sculptural silver pommel, long navy grip and compact silver crossguard. Pommel CENTRAL base, grip axis, guard center, blade centerline and tip all lie on ONE STRAIGHT line. Sword is a rigid straight object even during rotation. Curve only the motion ribbon, NEVER the steel blade. Clearly readable forked pommel near the backward hand; no generic round ball and no extra handle.
Style: graphic 2D fantasy card art matching the original-game style inputs: broad flat color blocks, angular chunky silhouettes, 2-4 hard cel-shaded color planes per material, large deliberate BLACK shapes, exaggerated perspective and one clean action. No realistic metal reflections, tiny rivets, individually rendered scales or dense engraving. Subject simplified into bold graphic forms.
Composition: body twist occupies central/right 70% of frame, strong low diagonal steel blade runs into lower-left foreground. Single broad CYAN/near-white elliptical slash ribbon winds behind the sword and around waist height, visibly separate from the straight blade, framing the low rotation without covering the hands. Minimal dark navy/purple background made of large curved shadow shapes; silver/navy armor, saturated cyan rim and white accent. Leg placement may crop at lower edge, but hips, bent front knee, free fist, sword hand, straight blade and forked pommel are readable at 250x190.
Avoid: text, UI, card frame or card-shaped rectangles, numbers, logo, watermark, two-handed grip, front-facing static pose, two swords, duplicate handle, bent blade, twisted grip axis, exposed face, blue cloth face mask, glowing orange eye, photo, painterly rendering, cinematic lighting, cluttered scenery, fine ornamental noise.
